root.bookTitle: Bujji & Kanna – A Love Written by Time

intro.title: A Story Meant to Happen
intro.subtitle: Some loves are written slowly… but deeply

pages.content:
2010 lo, chinna village lo jarige **Gangamma Thirunala event** tho ee story start ayyindi.
Chala rojula taruvatha event jarugutondani, village motham lighting, sound, colours tho full lively ga undi.
Madhu family kuda vachcharu — mainly because idi tana **ammamma gaari village**.

Akkada 10 years unna **Madhu**, chinnodu, innocent ga, relatives tho nadusthu event ni enjoy chestunnadu.

Ala crowd lo nadusthunnappudu…
Suddenly Madhu steps stop ayyayi.

Because he saw **her**.

**Joint wheel** lo, unna small boxes lo oka box meeda oka chinna ammayi kurchoni undi — **Priyanka**.
6–7 years, cute ribbons, bright eyes, and that small chinnari smile.

Madhu ki aame evaro teliyadu.
motta modatisaari thanu aa ammayi sorry sorry aa chinnari ni choosaadu.

Kani aa one second lo tana heart lo oka **first unknown feeling** puttindi.
Oka chinna prema spark laga…
Oka soft excitement chest lo kalisindi.
Madhu aa chinnaari ni choodadam first time anedi entha njm oo,
thana heart lo vachina aa new feeling kooda first time annadi anthey njm.

Priyanka Madhu ni gamaninchatledu.
Kani Madhu… aame joint wheel box lo kurchoni unde aa image ni…
Life lo first time *feel* ayyadu.

That Gangamma Thirunala event madhya…
Sounds, lights, people — anni blur ayipoyayi.
Priyanka matrame tana world lo clear ga undipoyindi.

Ala…
Rendu chinnari jeevithallo oka **silent beginning** start ayyindi.

Gangamma Thirunala event ayyaka, Madhu family tana **ammamma gaari illu** ki tirigi vachcharu.
Evening breeze, chinna village sounds, andharkanna deep ga Madhu mind lo okkate repeating…

**“Aame evaru? Malli eppudu chooshaanu…”**

Cot mida kurchoni, legs dangle chesthu, 10 years unna chinnodu laaga kaadu…
Oka deep thought lo undipoyadu.
Aa joint wheel lo chusina Priyanka image — rounds lo revolve avuthune undi.

Kaani…
Problem okkate.
Village anta chusinappudu kuda aame dorakaledu.

Madhu:
**“Evaru aa ammayi… epudu mallli kanipistundi…”**
Ani inside lo muttering.

Appude…
House door daggara okkasari chinna sound.

Priyanka!

Aame tana peddamma illu ki means Madhu ammamma illu ki, happily running ga ochindi.
Because **Priyanka house, Madhu ammamma gari house pakkapakkane**.

Madhu freeze ayipoyadu.
Heart lo aa same spark.
Chinnari Priyanka matram emi gamaninchakunda inside ki vachchi, something take chesi velipoyindi.

Kaani Madhu…
Eyes full ga aame mida ne.
Oka moment lo tana world again silent.

Aame vellipoyina tharvatha, Madhu immediate ga tana mother ni adigadu:

**“Amma… aa ammayi evaru?”**

Mother smile tho reply ichindi:

**“Aame… nee cousin Priyanka. Mana relatives ee vallu.”**

Madhu ears lo okkate echo ayyindi —

**Cousin.**

A word he never heard properly.
A word he didn’t understand.

So he asked again, innocently:

**“Amma… cousin ante enti?”**

Mother laughing ga, simple ga cheppindi:

**“Ante… nuvvu pelli chesukoovadaniki paniki vachche varusa nanna...”**

A sentence…
Madhu heart lo bullet laga padindi.

Tana feeling Priyanka gurinchi kadu…
**Aa cousin ane word gurinchi.**
Adhi new, confusing, scary, unknown emotion.

At 10 years old…
Love ante teliyadu.
Feeling ante teliyadu.
Kaani aa roju, aa word tho life lo **first pain**, **first confusion**, **first spark** start ayyayi.

The story didn’t begin with love…
It began with **that one word**.

**Cousin.**

2012.

Exactly rendu years taruvāta… the same village lo,
**Priyanka peddamma kuthuri (akka) marriage** jarugutondi.
And the groom…
**Madhu side nundi vadina**.

One single marriage…
But two small hearts ki **second meeting**.

Appatiki Priyanka ki **9–10 years**,
Madhu ki **12–13 years**.
Innocence inkā undi…
But understanding konchem perigindi.

Ippudu rendu well aware —
**“We are cousins.”**

A knowledge valla…
Matladadam ante okka strange shyness.

Because marriage lo relatives ante teasing masters:

*“Ayyo ayyo… bava maradallu kalisi matladutunnaru… eppudu pelli?”*

Ala evaraina joke chesthe,
Priyanka cheeks full red,
Madhu eyes down…
Iddaru silent ga side ki vellipotharu.

Kani…
Shyness unna, conversation avoid cheyyaleni moments kuda vachchai.

Kitchen lo water thechukodaniki vellina Priyanka, plate tiskodaniki vachhina Madhu…
Ala okkasari face-to-face.

Priyanka little smile…
Madhu small laugh…
Their first natural **“Hi…”**.

Aame okkasari by mistake:

**“Anna… water ivvava?”**

Madhu immediate ga shock:

Priyanka shy ga:

**“Sorry… Madhu…”**

Aa word —
Madhu.
Direct, simple, soft.
Madhu inside lo deep echo ayindi.

Madhu kuda, aame ni **Priyanka** ane pilichevaadu.
No “cousin words”.
No “bava” or “mardal”.
Just names.
Just comfort.

Marriage full busy, loud, crowded…
Kani rendu chinna hearts madhya, oka silent bond develop ayyindi.

Ala…
**Chinna smiles, accidental talks, and shared shyness** tho
Chapter 3 quietly ended —
Feelings little deeper…
Understanding little stronger.

2014.

Rendu samvatsarāla tharvatha…
**inkoka marriage**.
This time, Madhu side lo —
**Peddamma koothuru wedding**.

Madhu ippudu **14–15 years**,
Priyanka **11–12 years**.
Age perigina kooda…
Hearts lo innocence, feelings matram inkā fresh ga.

Morning nunchi Madhu relatives tho full busy —
Laughs, jokes, fun…
Normal village marriage vibe.

Alaa…
Suddenly, **Priyanka family** ochindi.
No warning… no hint…
Just one sudden arrival.

Madhu heart lo instant **tension strike**.
Aayana face immediate serious…
Laughs stop…
And he quietly slipped outside the house.

Inside, Priyanka happily greeting everyone:

**“Ella unnaru andharu? Baga unnara?”**

Chinnari kaadhu ippudu…
Konchem matured tone.

Ame greetings complete ayyaka…
She stepped outside alone…
 
Direct ga Madhu degara ochi,
Soft ga, confident ga:

**“Baagunnava madhu…?”**

Madhu inside lo heartbeats fast…
Kaani mouth lo matram short reply:

**“Baane unnā….”**

No **“Nuv ella unnavu?”**,
No full conversation.
Just shyness, just escape.

He walked away quickly.
Priyanka face lo slight disappointment…
Kaani she didn’t show it much.

But marriages are long…
Half-day lo Matladakapovadam impossible kaadhu.
By evening…
Madhu’s starting problem melt ayipoyindi.

Priyanka again smiled at him,
This time Madhu smiled back properly.

Slow ga…
Conversation pick up ayyindi.
Chinna jokes, small teasing…
A pure comfort returned.

Appude konni relatives chusi fun ga:

**“Ado ado… bava maradallu matladutunnaru… okay okay, continue…”**

Madhu cheeks light red…
Priyanka laugh control chesthu…

Oka moment lo,
Crowd lo confuse ayye time,
Madhu casually **her hand hold chesadu**,
Just to guide, just to say something…

But that small touch…
Both felt something deep.
Madhu definitely felt it.
Priyanka expression subtle…
But something moved in her heart too.

Alaa…
**Peddamma Koothuru marriage** kuda complete.
But what really completed was…
Childhood strangers → shy cousins →
**Two hearts slowly discovering each other.**

Chapter 4 ends with a soft glow…
And a silent beginning of something big.

2018 year.
Madhu ki appudu **18–19 years** untayi.
Priyanka ki around **15–16 years**.

Ippatiki iddaru chinna pillalu kaadhu.
Konni feelings ardham ayyei… konni shyness, attraction…
mari relatives mundu konchem careful ga behave cheyyalani telisindi.

Aa samvatsaram Priyanka intlo small celebration plan chesaru.
Tana nanna first floor kattadam complete ayyindi kabatti,
okka chinna party arrange chesaru.
Madhu family kuda invite ayyindi.

Madhu akkada ki vellaga atmosphere konchem different ga anipinchindi.
Iddaru ippudu normal ga mataadey stage ki ochchesaru,
shyness thaggipotunnadi…
kaani lopala okka light blush, okka silent spark iddarlo untunde.

Kids pakkaki kadili kadili aadutunte,
elders pakkana matladutunte,
akkada jarigina **small moment** matram both heart lo deep ga undipoyindi...

**Rubik’s Cube moment.**

Madhu tana **3×3 Rubik’s Cube** tiskoni vachadu.
A recent ga solve chesi nerchukunna hobby.

Priyanka first time adhi solve chesthunna Madhu ni chusi
okka surprise + admiration look ichindi.

“**Nuvvu idi solve chesthava?**” ani wide eyes tho adigindi.

Madhu soft ga navvadu:
“**Haa… ippudu niku kuda nerpista.**”

Chaalu… aa oka sentence tho atmosphere change aipoyindi.

Priyanka tana chotu nunchi move ayi,
Madhu daggara **very close** ga kurchundi.
A first closeness…
but natural ga, reason Cube kabatti.

Madhu step by step cheppadam start chesadu—
colors ela match cheyyali,
rotations ela cheyyali,
patterns ela gurthupettukovali.

Teaching lopala iddari hands konni sarlu touch ayayi…
empty ga, accidental ga…
kaani feelings lo intha empty kaaledu.

Relatives andariki iddaru **“Rubik’s Cube ne chustunnaru”** anipinchadam vallaa,
no teasing… no drama.
Madhu ki Priyanka tho inka ekkuva time dorikindi.
Priyanka genuine ga interest chupinchindi.
Madhu pakkanunchi levakunda solve cheyadaniki try chesthunde,
Madhu ki adi nachichindi.

Idi iddari life lo **first long time together**.
Laughs, teasing, small fights…
Madhu chinnaga tease chesthe
Priyanka “Peh!” ani light ga hit chesthundi.

Aa chemistry slow gaa… silent gaa…
heart lo settle ayipotundi rendu vaallaki.

Event ayyaka, Priyanka already konni steps solve chesthundani proud ga andariki chupinchindi.
Madhu pakkana nunchi soft smile tho chusthune unnadu.
A smile… Priyanka kosame.

Aa party ayipoyindi...
kani **Rubik’s Cube moment** matram iddari life lo permanent ayipoyindi.

*The moment Madhu realised love also has rules… painful rules.*

2018 year.
Madhu ki appudu **18 years** daggara age.
Life lo oka important phase —
Madhu **own sister marriage matches** start ayyayi.

House lo peddalu, relatives, panulu…
matches choodadam, gothralu verify cheyyadam,
horoscopes, caste subdivision — anni rounds nadusthunnayi.

A time lo Madhu life ni completely marchipettese
**one truth** first time telisindi…

**Modallu – Thirumandarallu**

Madhu caste lo okka **sub-caste system** undedi.
Two groups:

* **Modallu**
* **Thirumandarallu**

And rule enti ante…
*Thirumandarallu → must marry Thirumandarallu.*
*Modallu → must marry Modallu.*

Cross marriage okay kaadu…
not legally — but emotionally, culturally, mythically…
People strongly believe it.

Madhu family lo andariki telisina rule idi.
Kaani Madhu ki matram **2018–2019** lo maatrame
clear ga strike ayyindi —
tana sister marriage match conversations valla.

Madhu himself is **Thirumandarallu**.
Tana sister kuda ade.

So matches search chesthunna peddalu
constant ga cheptu unnar:

**“Thirumandarallu vallatone match choodali…”**

Madhu silent ga vinnadu…
kani heart lo okka shock laaga feel ayyadu.



**Priyanka is Modallu.**

Aa moment lone
Madhu mind lo flash ayyindi
**only one face… Priyanka.**

Years nunchi feelings unde…
valalo silent understanding unde…
kani oka official dream kuda kaaledu.
He was too young earlier.

But ippudu…
rules vinagane
heart lo okka soft crack laaga kaligindi.

Madhu thought to himself:

**“Nenu Thirumandarallu…
Aame Modallu…
Ante… nenu eligible kaadhaa?”**

Status difference inka pain meedha sare…
Priyanka family koncham rich…
Madhu family simple middle.

Also **sub-caste difference**?
Adi ayithe break cheyyadaniki kastam,
especially village families lo.

Madhu kooda ardham chesukunnadu…
*Ee feeling ki future unda?
Ledu?*

**He didn’t kill the feeling… he just locked it**

Madhu heart lo Priyanka gurinchi
oka soft love feeling already undedi.
Childhood nundi slow ga peri ayina affection.

Kaani ippudu
**he felt he cannot reach her.**
Not because she doesn’t like him…
but because **rules** don’t allow it.

So Madhu chesina only thing:

**He didn’t delete the feeling.
He didn’t express it.
He just placed it gently inside his heart…
and locked it in silence.**

Priyanka ki teliyadu…
Madhu matram aalochinchadu…

Ilaage Chapter 6 end ayipoyindi —
okka chinna truth,
Madhu heart lo pedda silent pain.

*Sometimes destiny shows the same name twice… just to remind you what you truly want.*

Intermediate 2nd year.
Madhu life lo oka new phase —
classes, exams, friends, tuition…
and silent ga heart lo inka **original Priyanka** memories undeyi.

But oka roju…
class lo roll number call chesthunnaru.

**“Priyanka…”**

A name vintane
Madhu heart okka second beat miss ayindi.
Instant ga aa name lo
**childhood Priyanka** reflection kanipinchindi.

Aame kaadu…
kotha ammayi.
Classmate.
Chala calm, simple, decent girl.

Kaani **that name**…
that name alone
Madhu lo malli soft feeling ni start chesindi.



**He didn’t love the girl… he loved the name**

Madhu himself ardam kaledu initially.
Why is he feeling something?
Is it attraction?
Is it real love?
Or is it just the *name* haunting him?

Truth simple:
**Madhu wants Priyanka…
but he knows he can never marry the real Priyanka.
So his heart started loving the name itself.**

Ilaa oka innocent emotional confusion lo
Madhu slow ga
**second Priyanka** meeda feeling develop chesadu.



**Everything matched… except the main thing**

Oka point lo, Madhu chala explore chesadu:

* Aame **Thirumandarallu**
* Same caste
* Same family background
* Good behaviour
* Good heart

Literally **perfect match** ani anipinchindi.
Fate telling him:

**“This Priyanka is allowed…
…maybe this is your destiny.”**

Madhu heart lo confidence vacchindi.
Ippudu love cheppalani decide chesadu.

**The truth hits softly, not harshly**

Oka gentle moment lo,
Madhu tana feelings anni genuine ga share chesadu.

Aame chinna silent smile tho reply ichindi:

**“Madhu…
Nenu already okarina love lo unna…
Nenu ninnu respect chesthanu…
manam friends ga continue avvachu.”**

Adhi harsh ga kaadu,
soft, respectful, kind rejection.

A moment lo Madhu heart lo
chinna crack ayyindi…
kani break kaaledu.

Reason?

Because Madhu knew
**this was not real love…
this was the shadow of another Priyanka.**

**They didn’t become lovers… but became very good friends**

From that day
love lekunda
okka pure friendship start ayyindi.

Laughing,
helping in studies,
group chats…
anni normal ayyayi.

Madhu respect chesadu.
Aame honesty appreciate chesadu.

Years later,
aame tana love tho **marriage** ayyindi.
Madhu felt happy for her,
because she deserved that happiness.



**A small chapter closed…

but the real story still waiting.**

Ee chapter Madhu ki oka lesson ichindi:

**“Real love doesn’t get replaced.
Even with the same name.”**

And deep inside…
the *childhood Priyanka* feeling —
the true seed planted in 2010 —
was still quietly alive.

2020 year.
Madhu ki **20 years**, Priyanka ki **17 years**.
Iddaru ippudu **love ni, feelings ni, maturity ni, ardham chesukunnaru**.
Childhood innocence kadhu… ippudu subtle emotions, unspoken thoughts, silent glances.

Aa samvatsaram, Madhu **tana sister marriage preparation lo busy**.
Planning, arrangements, money work…
chala hectic schedule.

Priyanka initially **marriage ki vachindi kaadu**.
Aame matrame last main event ki vellindi.
Total ga 3–4 hours matrame akkada undi.

Madhu busy ga andariki instructions ivvadam, managing, running around…
Aame silent ga corner lo undi.

Suddenly… Madhu **aame ni chusi**…
thanu edusthundi ani gamaninchaadu..

Adi **Madhu kosam kaadu…**
Adi ardham avvaledu.
Asal priyanka madhu ni choodaledu

**“Ela… why she is crying? Emi ayindi?”**
Thanaki ardham kaaledu…
Aame face lo chinna princess-like sadness, distant ga feel ayi…
Madhu **approach cheyyalani try chesadu**.
Kaani ippudu…
he realized: **she is like a princess… and I am not suitable… cannot reach… cannot touch that world.**

So Madhu just stood, **silent observer**.
He watched her…
but **did not move**,
did not question,
did not interfere.

Aame **unknowingly crying… not because of Madhu**,
kaani Madhu heart lo subtle tension, worry, curiosity remain ayi.

After some time…
aame **disappeared from the event** quietly.

Madhu returned to his work…
busy managing sister’s marriage…
but heart lo **oka chinna soft wound** undi.

Ilaage Chapter 8 end ayiindi—
**silent glances, unspoken feelings, distance, and soft heartbreak**.

chapters.chapterTitle: The Digital Spark and the Pause (2022–2023)

pages.content:
2022 year, September 13th.
Madhu **22 years old**, Priyanka **19 years old**.
Madhu Hyderabad lo…
**software engineering coaching**, computer science studies… busy with life, future planning.

Aa roju, Madhu phone check chesthunnadu…
Instagram app open chesadu, Reels upload, stories… curiosity tho scroll chesthunnadu.

Suddenly, **Priyanka account** kanipinchi… (priyankavannam1)
heart **soft ga jump ayyindi**.
Madhu **direct ga follow chesadu**,
luckily Priyanka **accept chesindi**.

Madhu small message chesaadu:
**“Hi”**

And **connection start ayyindi…**
slow ga, easy ga…
first month, second month…
light chat, casual talk, laughs, memories…
childhood memories come back… nostalgia soft ga spread ayyindi.

**The Agreement**

Priyanka matladindi:
**“Madhu… love story kaadu…
Mana caste difference undi…
Naaku marriage decisions father decide chestaru…
So, future lo marriage possibility ledhu…
Only friendship matrame maintain cheyyali.”**

Madhu respect chesadu, accept chesadu…
heart lo subtle pain, kani respect intact.



**Friendship Becomes More… Slowly**

Two months, three months…
chat deepen ayyindi.
Heart open, personal questions, emotional sharing…
soft love hints start ayyayi.
Priyanka and Madhu **cousins,** but connection strong, heartfelt…
silent affection start ayyindi.
Priyanka Madhu ni **Bava** ani pilavadam...
Madhu Priyanka ni **Bujji** ani pilavadam

Then, January 7th — Priyanka birthday.
Madhu **beautiful gift ichadu**.
Alanti gift evaru ippati varuku thana gf ki ichchivundadu.
Priyanka **very happy, emotional**, deep love feelings surface.
Instagram chat theme **love mood ki change ayi…**
feeling start slowly growing stronger.

**The Pause**

Kaani, **February 2023** lo Priyanka cautious ayyindi.
Aame message istundi:

**“Madhu… I think we are doing mistake…
Our chat is slowly becoming lover-like…
I cannot continue like this…
We should stop… leave this…
Sorry, please respect me.”**

Madhu **respectfully accept chesadu**.
Pain soft, but acceptable…
Priyanka ki kuda chinna hurt,
both silent… but understanding.

Ilaage, February 2023 lo **temporary separation** start ayi…
silent pause in their connection,
heart lo soft ache,
but memory and feelings still alive.

2023, mid-year.

Some months later, **job start ayina tarvata**,
Madhu **first time message chesadu**.
Priyanka **same reply istundi**:
**“Please, message cheyyaku…”**
Madhu **silent ga accept chesadu**… nothing more.

**Slow Interest Rekindled**

2024, mid-year, 
Madhu, after a long time, **Priyanka village ki vachadu**.
Years pass ayyi, childhood and teen memories mind lo…
heart lo still soft feelings undi.

Priyanka distance lo undi… but **interest thodu grow ayyindi**.
Lively ga Madhu ni chusi, heart lo curiosity… subtle emotions slowly surface.

Event complete ayyaka, Madhu **house ki return ayyadu**,
phone check chesadu…
2 days tarvata, **first message Priyanka nundi**:

**“Hlo”**
Normal, light, casual chat…
no deep late-night chatting, no pressure…
just soft playful **bond rekindle**.

Madhu **shock ayyadu**…
Priyanka normal ga, playful ga… chatting start chesindi.
Small words… soft laughs…
heart connection **slowly rekindle**.

**Increasing Bond**

Some months, few more visits…
Madhu repeated Priyanka village visits…
Priyanka gradually **more interest show chesindi**,
lively ga, subtly… softly…
she started chatting more frequently, light playful tone…
soft teasing, smiles in texts…

Ilaage, 2024 lo **Priyanka – Madhu connection gradually rekindle ayi**,
chatting **increase ayi**,
bond strong but soft, natural, effortless.

2025, May month.
Madhu **Priyanka village ki vachadu**…
party, dinner purpose tho.

Dinner lo, **Priyanka tho soft playful interaction**…
light teasing, smiles, laughter…
small moments, heart connection grow ayyindi…
but Madhu **feelings still restrained**.
He has feelings… kani **marriage, future thoughts, serious plans… not yet**.
Heart lo soft love, but **filtered**… careful, controlled.



**The Marriage Question**

Some days tarvata, Priyanka **direct ga adigindi**:
**“Bava… shall we marry?”**

Madhu **shock ayyadu**…
soft hesitation…
heart lo emotions, practical realities kuda mind lo:

* **Different sub-caste**
* **Financial gap** (Priyanka family richer than Madhu)
* **Father approval issue**

Madhu **explained softly**:
**“Bujji… idhi easy kaadu…
Mana caste difference, family differences…
Future lo complications vachayi…”**

Priyanka **understood, smiled softly**, explained:
**“Neeku growth kavali…
Salary, position improve chesuko…
Ilaage, careful planning… taruvata easy ga marry chesukovachu…
Caste issue minor ga ignore cheyyachu…
Patience tho step by step cheyyali…
Bava… actual love start chestham…
Kaani filtered love…
Any problem like father rejection unte…
We will leave, no pressure…
Neither devadas, neither dull…
Always happy, normal life maintain…
Step by step… careful ga…”**

Madhu **heart fully accept chesadu**…
soft filtered love start ayyindi.
This is **real love**, careful, mature, but emotional…
Mutual understanding, respect, and patience lo strong foundation build ayyindi.

**June 7th, 2025.**
Priyanka **first time Madhu house ki vachindi**, summer holidays and some event reason tho.

From the first step, **jokes, laughter, teasing** start ayyindi.
Conversation lively, playful…
**Filtered love, hesitation—gone.**
Now, **pure, honest emotions start**, heart to heart.

Even if family members nearby unte, **they will chat privately, softly**, silent smiles and glances…
And whenever alone, **full expression of love**—no hiding, no restraint.

**June 8th – First Hug**

Next day, **June 8th**, first hug.
That hug **changed everything**.
Madhu and Priyanka realized,
**“Idhi real love… heart to heart… nothing hidden.”**

After hug, Priyanka **vachindi village ki**, kani heart lo love fully bloom ayyindi.
Both started expressing:
**“I love you”**… **“I love you too”**…
Sharing love emojis, playful messages, future thoughts.

**Talking About Future**

* “If we marry, how we will treat each other?”
* “Children names… future planning… dreams…”

Priyanka **curious and full of love**,
Madhu **heart full of emotion but tension**:
**“What if your father does not accept me? How to convince him?”**

Madhu expressed **deep feelings**:
**“Bujji… I want to marry you…
I love you only…
We will figure out everything else…**

Priyanka **gets emotional**, heart melts…
**True love starts—pure, fearless, and deep.**

Some months later, **Madhu Priyanka village ki vachadu**.
That visit was **very special… emotional… heart-melting**.
Because this is thier **3rd aniversary 😍❤️💕😘**
**First kiss happened.**
They **shared gifts**—like rings.

Madhu kooda Priyanka meda lo **chain** vasaadu.



**The Hug and Heartfelt Words**

Ala Priyanka medalo chain vesthunnappudu, **Priyanka hugged Madhu directly**.
Madhu **felt overwhelmed**—heart totally melted.

He asked softly:
**“Bujji… Enduku hug chesukuntunnav chain vesthunte?”**

Priyanka smiled and said:
**“Naaki endukooo nuvvu thaali kaduthunnattu anipisthundi…
Waste fellow! urike chain veyadam kaadu nuvvu kooda dinni feel avvu…
I love you forever bava.”**

And then… **she kissed him softly**.
She whispered:
**“I want to be with you… always…”**



**Effect on Madhu**

Appudu **changed everything again**.
Love became **even more pure, more deep, more fearless**.
Madhu’s heart was fully hers now,
and he realized **Inka thaggedele, Edaina gaani choosukundam**.

**Bujji (Priyanka)** and **Kanna (Madhu)** madhya love **peak stage** ki reach ayindi.

Ippudu:

* Names kaadu… **Bujji & Kanna**
* Full love, full care
* Future dreams
* Daily chatting
* Emojis, feelings, everything

They are **deeply in love** ❤️



**Two Sides of Madhu**

Priyanka Madhu tho unnapudu:

* Madhu baaga navvutadu
* Jokes vestadu
* Love express chestadu
* Full happy ga untadu

**But…**

Priyanka lenappudu,
Madhu okkadiga unnapudu,
his mind slowly starts hurting him.

He thinks:

* *“Am I really correct for her?”*
* *“She comes from a very rich family…”*
* *“Nenu tanaki future lo happiness ivvagalana?”*

Salary gurinchi:

* *“Ippudu 70k earn chestunna”*
* *“Future lo 1L or 1.5L vachina…”*
* *“Still, will she be happy?”*

Family difference gurinchi fear:

* Rich family
* Lifestyle difference



**A Painful Decision**

Chaala deep pain tho,
Madhu oka decision tiskuntadu.

> **“Love ante compulsory marriage kaadu…”**
> **“Love ante tana happiness…”**

He convinces himself:

* *“Her father will find a perfect man for her”*
* *“She will be more happy without me”*
* *“Naa tho unte maybe initial ga happy…”*
* *“Later struggles untayi emo”*

So finally,
**Madhu decides to sacrifice his love.**

**Fake Truth – Chat Lo Start**

Madhu decide ayyadu:
👉 **She should leave me. Only when she hate me.**

So chat lo slowly start chestadu.

**Madhu:**

> *“Bujji… naku konni bad habits unnayi.”*
> *“I drink… I smoke.”*
> *“Earlier nenu neeki cheppaledu.”*

**Priyanka shocked… but replies immediately:**

**Priyanka:**

> *“Enduku abaddam cheppav?”*
> *“It’s okay kannaaa.”*
> *“Ee reason kosam nannu vadilestava?”*
> *“Shut up.”*
> *“Ippatinunchi thagaku anthey kada.”*

**Madhu:**

> *“Nenu vatini vadalalenu.”*
> *“I am addicted.”*

**Priyanka (still loving):**

> *“Hmmm…”*
> *“Health paadavuthundi kannaa…”*
> *“Okay… Sare le chinna chinna ga maanedduvule..”*
> *“But don’t leave me for this.”*



**The Cruel Lie (Chat Turning Point)**

Madhu heart inka break avtundi.
*“Bad habits tho kuda thanu accept chestundi…”*

So he types the **most dangerous lie**.

**Madhu:**

> *“Naku earlier physical relationships kooda unnayi.”*
> *“Intermediate time lo.”*
> *“Nenu nee life disturb cheyyalenu.”*
> *“You deserve better.”*

**Priyanka:**

> *“Kannaa Apaddaalu cheppaku.”*
> *“Nenu ninnu blindly trust chesanu.”*
> *“Nuvvu alanti vaadivi kaadu.”*

**Madhu:**

> *“Nenu alantivaadine...”*

ala madhu serious avuthaadu

Ee messages chadivina taruvata,
**Priyanka completely shocked.**

Konni seconds typing indicator…
Tarvata okate message.

**Priyanka:**

> *“You cheated me.”*
> *“Nenu ninnu blindly trust chesanu.”*

Tarvata…
**She stops replying.**
No messages.
No typing.
Just silence.

**Two Hearts, Same Pain**

Chat silent ayyaka:

* **Madhu breaks completely**

  * Guilt
  * Crying
  * Self-hatred
  * Love sacrifice pain

* **Priyanka also cries alone**

  * Shock
  * Betrayal
  * Broken trust
  * Still loving him

Both are crying.
Both are loving.
But **both are broken.**


**End of Chapter 14**

💔 Love without hate
💔 Sacrifice without truth
💔 Silence louder than words

**2025 October 7th.**

Chat silent ayyi **two days** complete ayyai.

Madhu (Kanna) phone chudatam kuda manesadu.
Guilt, pain, self-hate tho silent ga undipoyadu.



**After Two Days – Priyanka Messages Again**

Suddenly…
Notification.

**Message from Bujji.**

Madhu heart skip ayindi.

**Priyanka:**

> *“Kanna…”*
> *“Sorry.”*
> *“It’s okay.”*
> *“Past lo nuvvu em chesina parledhu.”*
> *“Nuvvu ippudu naatho unnaavu kada.”*
> *“Adhi chaalu.”*
> *“Past is past.”*
> *“Nannu vadileyaku.”*
> *“Please marry me.”*
> *“Nenu ninnu vadilalenu.”*
> *“Nuvve naa life.”*

Ee messages chadivina ventane…
**Madhu breaks down again.**

Tears…
Hands shaking…
Mind blank.

*“Ilaanti truth telisina taruvata kuda…”*
*“Still she loves me?”*

**Madhu’s Fear Turns Cruel**

Madhu mind lo okate thought:

> *“She will never leave me unless I break her completely.”*

So…
He decides to become **cruel on purpose**.

**Madhu Replies – Rudely (On Purpose)**

**Madhu:**

> *“Bujji… past is past ani nuvvu antunnav.”*
> *“Ante enti artham ?”*
> *“Ante nuvvu kuda past lo chaala mandi tho tirigav kada.”*
> *“Anduke le past is past antunnav.”*
> *“Naku doubts vastunnayi.”*

Priyanka stunned.

**Priyanka:**

> *“What are you saying?”*
> *“Nenu alanti ammayini kaadu.”*
> *“Nuvvu nannu ela doubt chestunnav?”*

**Madhu (cold & repeated):**

> *“Nenu doubts feel avtunna.”*
> *“Nuvvu kuda bad person ey.”*
> *“Naku clarity ledu.”*



**Priyanka Breaks Completely**

Eyes full tears.
Hands shaking while typing.

**Priyanka:**

> *“Nenu ninnu true ga love chesanu.”*
> *“Nuvvu nannu ala matladutunnav?”*
> *“I trusted you.”*

But Madhu listens to nothing.

He keeps repeating the same lines.
No explanation.
No softness.

**The Final Decision**

Finally…
Priyanka heart **completely breaks**.

She types the last message.

**Priyanka:**

> *“Enough.”*
> *“I can’t do this anymore.”*
> *“Let’s stop.”*

Madhu replies immediately.

**Madhu:**

> *“Okay.”*
> *“Let’s break up.”*



**End of Everything**

Chat ends.
No blocks.
No last seen drama.
Just **silence**.

Two people who loved deeply…
Destroyed each other to protect each other.

* **Priyanka** – broken, confused, empty
* **Madhu** – alive, but dead inside



**End of Chapter 15**

💔 Love sacrificed
💔 Truth hidden
💔 Breakup done on purpose

chapters.chapterTitle: The Love That Refused to Die (October–November 2025)

pages.content:
Breakup ayyaka…
Silence vachindi.

But **love matram alaane undi**.



**One Week Later**

Breakup ayyi **one week** complete ayindi.

Suddenly…
Notification.

**Message from Priyanka.**

Madhu chusadu.
Reply ivvaledu.

**Priyanka:**

> *“Kanna…”*
> *“Nenu alanti ammayi kaadu.”*
> *“Please nannu nammu.”*
> *“Nenu good person.”*

Madhu phone lock chesadu.
Heart lo pain perigindi.
But reply ivvaledu.

**Weeks Passing… Same Pattern**

**Every week… once.**

Priyanka message chestundi.
Madhu chustadu.
But silence.

* One week
* Two weeks
* Three weeks

Messages tone change avtundi.
Hope → Fear → Tears.

**November 15, 2025 – The Breaking Point**

Ee roju…
**Everything changed.**

Priyanka messages continuous ga vastunnayi.

Madhu phone chetilo pattukoni…
Reply ivvaledu.
But **tears phone screen meeda padutunnayi.**



**Priyanka’s Long Message (Heart Completely Open)**

**Priyanka:**

> *“Kanna… please Kanna.”*
> *“Naa maatalu vinava?”*
> *“Nenu idhi cheptunnanu just because I want you.”*
> *“Nuvvu past lo em chesina naku parledhu.”*

Madhu tears wipe chesukuntadu.
Message scroll chestadu.

**Priyanka:**

> *“Nenu past lo em cheyyaledu Kanna.”*
> *“Please nammu.”*

Madhu hands shake avtunnayi.
Reply ledu.

**Then… She Uses the Most Painful Word**

**Priyanka:**

> *“Bava…”*
> *“Nuvvu naa bava kada?”*
> *“Please bava, naatho matladu.”*
> *“Nenu em tappu cheyyaledu bava.”*
> *“Nenu ala kaadu bava.”*

Madhu eyes close ayyai.



**Complete Surrender of Love**

**Priyanka:**

> *“Nuvvu kavali bava.”*
> *“Nuvvu kavali ante nenu emaina chestha.”*
> *“Naku em vaddu.”*
> *“Nenu anni sacrifice chestha.”*
> *“Nuvvu maatram undu.”*

> *“Nuvvu entha bad ga behave chesina parledhu.”*
> *“Entha tittina parledhu.”*
> *“Please naa character ni doubt cheyyaku.”*

> *“Nuvvu naa first love bava.”*
> *“Nuvve naa last love kuda.”*
> *“Nenu evaritho tiragaledu.”*
> *“Nenu evaritho relationship lo ledu.”*

> *“Oka ammayi malli malli thirigi neekosam vasthundi ante…”*
> *“Once think cheyyi.”*
> *“Enta love undo artham avtundi.”*

Madhu ee messages choodadam aapesaadu. Cell phone pakkan petti padukunnadu...

**End of Chapter 16**

💔 Love that begged
💔 Love that surrendered
💔 Love that was still ignored

Inka madhu alaane padukunnaadu. Nidra ravadam ledu.

Priyanak still waiting....

ala night 2:30 AM ayyindi.

Madhu still edusthoone unnnaadu padukookundaa...

ika phone theesukunnaadu message choosaaadu.
that bava pilavadam choosi a word choosi thanu okkasarigaa gattiga edchadam start chessadu.

aa lines Madhu ni **complete ga break** chesaayi.

**Madhu’s Message (Finally Sent)**

> *“Bujji…”*
> *“Nuvvu antha strong ani naku teliyaledu.”*
> *“Nenu silent ga unna prathi roju…”*
> *“Nuvvu fight chesav, wait chesav, hope pettukunnav.”*

Send.

Heart beats fast.

Seen ticks not yet come.



**Madhu Continues (Before Fear Stops Him)**

> *“Nenu ninnu push cheyyadaniki try chesanu…”*
> *“But nannu nene mosam chesukunnanu.”*
> *“Nuvvu weak kaadu.”*
> *“Nenu bayapadda.”*

Send.

**Seen ✔✔**

Seconds pass…

Then…

**Typing…**



**Priyanka’s Reply (Soft, Not Angry)**

> *“Kanna…”*
> *“Finally.”*

Madhu’s eyes fill.



**Priyanka**

> *“Nuvvu nannu leave cheyyadaniki reason lu create chesav ani naku telusu.”*
> *“Nuvvu bad person ani naku epudu anipinchaledu.”*
> *“Nuvvu bayapadutunnav ani telusu.”*

**Madhu Breaks Completely**

> *“Yes Bujji…”*
> *“Nenu bayapadda.”*
> *“Nee life ni spoil cheyyalani naku ledu.”*
> *“Nuvvu naku dorikina best gift.”*
> *“Nuvvu ekkada unna happy ga undaali anukunna.”*



**Priyanka’s Line That Changes Everything**

> *“Kanna…”*
> *“Nenu nee life lo guest kaadu.”*
> *“Nenu journey partner.”*
> *“Nuvvu fail ayina, nenu pakkane untanu.”*
> *“Nuvvu succeed ayina, nenu pakkane untanu.”*

Pause.

Then one more message.

> *“Nuvvu unte chaaaley ....”*



**Madhu’s Reply (Truth, No Drama)**

> *“I am sorr bujjamma...”*

Send.



**Priyanka (Immediate)**

> *“Its okay bavaaaa.... ”* ❤️

**Soft Anger – Like a Mother Scolding a Child**

Tone sudden ga maarutundi.

**Priyanka:**

> *“Idi enti bava?”*
> *“Naa happiness kosam ani…”*
> *“Naa character ni ila matladutava?”*

> *“Nuvvu nannu entha love chestunnav bava?”*
> *“Cheppu.”*

> *“Nenu ivala message cheyyakapothe…”*
> *“Nannu vadilese vaadiva?”*

> *“Vadilesi pothe champestha ninnu.”*

> *“Over think cheyyaku.”*
> *“Sensible ga undu.”*

> *“Nuvvu ela unna…”*
> *“Nenu nee pakkane unta.”*

> *“Nuvvu unte…”*
> *“Ade chaalu.”*

> *“Naku inkem akkarledu.”*
> *“I L U K”* ❤️


**Madhu’s Reply (Truth, No Drama)**

> *“I L U 2 B”* ❤️
> *“Bujjiiii Inkoosari Bava aneeee”* ❤️


**Priyanka:**

> *“Bavaaaa”*

**Madhu’s Reply (Truth, No Drama)**

> *“Wow...”* ❤️
> *“Inkoosaari aneeee”* ❤️

**Priyanka:**

> *“Bavaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa”*

**Madhu’s Reply (Truth, No Drama)**

> *“Wow...”* ❤️
> *“Inkokkasaari Nuvvu mathrame anelaa nannu mathrame anelaaa aneeee* ❤️

**Priyanka:**

> *“Baaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa”*

**Madhu’s Reply (Truth, No Drama)**

> *“🫠🫠🫠🫠🫠🫠”* ❤️

...
...
...



Just **two people choosing each other again**.



🌙 Love survived fear
🌙 Silence finally broke

After all those months of **pure love and closeness**, finally, Andaru valla meda doubt padadam start chessaru.
Some people noticed thier bonding, Konthamandi vallu matladedi kooda choosaru, valla gifts, valla moments.
Kaani evariki **no full confirmation**

But **Priyanka was very clear**— Okavela valla gurinchi valla nanna ki thelisthey thana dvara ne theliyaali, inkoo valla dwara vaddu ani.

She **planned everything carefully**:

* She wanted to **reveal thier love story herself**.
* She wanted it to be for the **purpose of marriage**, nothing else.
* She was **ready to take risks**, even if it affected her studies or daily life.
* Her **trust in Madhu** and in herself was stronger than any fear.

The plan was **set for her birthday, January 7th, 2026**.
On that day, she would **reveal everything**—thier jthierney, thier love, thier truth—to her father.

This chapter is **the present**, the turning point before the final step toward marriage,
and the story **pauses here**, for now…
